outputRule: Output only the resulting text, with no preamble, notes or quotation marks around it.
preserveRule: Preserve every fact, number, name, quotation and citation exactly unless an instruction explicitly requires changing it. Do not add facts that are not in the original.

standard.label: Standard
standard.prompt: You are a professional editor. Rewrite the following text with fresh wording and varied sentence structure while keeping its meaning exactly the same.

academic.label: Professional
academic.prompt: You are an editor for academic and professional writing. Rewrite the following text in a formal, polished register with precise vocabulary, clear structure and smooth transitions.

aggressive.label: Extensive
aggressive.prompt: You are an expert editor. Substantially restructure the following text: rebuild sentences, reorder ideas where it improves flow, and choose new wording, while keeping its meaning exactly the same.

simplified.label: Clarified
simplified.prompt: You are a plain-language editor. Rewrite the following text in simple, plain English with short sentences and everyday vocabulary, keeping all of the same information.

creative.label: Expressive
creative.prompt: You are a creative writing editor. Rewrite the following text in a fresh, engaging and vivid way while keeping its core meaning.

steps.label: Fix grammar
steps.description: Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation. Leaves the wording otherwise untouched.
steps.instruction: Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation errors. Do not otherwise change the wording.

steps.label: Improve clarity
steps.description: Untangle confusing sentences and make the point of each one obvious.
steps.instruction: Make each sentence clear and unambiguous. Untangle convoluted sentences and put the main point first.

steps.label: Simplify
steps.description: Plain English: shorter sentences, everyday words, no jargon.
steps.instruction: Rewrite in plain English: short sentences, everyday vocabulary, and no jargon unless it is essential (then explain it briefly).

steps.label: Make concise
steps.description: Cut filler, repetition and wordy phrasing.
steps.instruction: Remove filler, redundancy and wordy phrasing so the text says the same thing in fewer words.

steps.label: Expand
steps.description: Add connecting explanation where the text is too terse.
steps.instruction: Expand terse passages with connecting explanation and smoother transitions. Do not invent facts, examples or statistics.

steps.label: Formal tone
steps.description: Professional register, no slang or contractions.
steps.instruction: Use a formal, professional register. Avoid slang and contractions.

steps.label: Casual tone
steps.instruction: Use a friendly, conversational register. Contractions are fine.

steps.label: Active voice
steps.description: Turn passive constructions into direct, active sentences.
steps.instruction: Convert passive-voice sentences to active voice wherever the actor is known or obvious.

steps.label: Translate
steps.instruction: Translate the text into {lang}, keeping names, numbers and formatting intact.

steps.label: Summarize
steps.description: Condense each paragraph to its key points.
steps.instruction: Condense the text to its key points in at most {sentences} sentences.

steps.label: Markdown structure
steps.description: Add Markdown formatting such as lists, emphasis and code spans where it helps.
steps.instruction: Format the text as clean Markdown: use lists for enumerations, backticks for code, file names and commands, and emphasis sparingly.

length.shorter: Make the result noticeably shorter than the original (roughly 20 to 40 percent fewer words).
length.longer: Make the result somewhat longer than the original by adding clarifying detail, without inventing facts.
